period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); comparator column is 31.12.2012. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2013 (H1, Jan-Jun). CONSOLIDATED basis, NOT Solo -- this bank's interim quarterly/half-yearly filings for FY2011-FY2015(Q1) were published ONLY on a Consolidated basis (Standard Bank Limited and its subsidiaries: Standard Exchange Co. (UK) Ltd., Standard Co. (USA) Inc., SBL Capital Management Ltd., and from 2012/2013 onward Standard Bank Securities Ltd.); no separate Solo statement exists in the interim filing format used during this period (confirmed by exhaustively reading every page of each filing -- these are either a single condensed page or a short multi-page filing containing exactly one Balance Sheet/P&L, always headed 'Consolidated'). This differs from the main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is Solo throughout. Flagged per project convention for interim/annual basis mismatches (cf. PREMIERBAN, TRUSTBANK, DHAKABANK, PRIMEBANK, ALARABANK in _HANDOFF.md). Cross-check: this quarter's own comparator column for the prior Dec-31 is Consolidated and will therefore be slightly ABOVE (not equal to) this dataset's own Solo Q4 figure for the same date -- this is expected, not an error. pdftotext extraction of this specific PDF was systematically digit-corrupted (same class of defect the project separately found in this bank's own FY2012 annual report); re-extracted via OCR (300dpi) instead. total_equity is a residual, computed as Total Liabilities+Equity (=Total Assets, reported exactly) minus Total Liabilities (reported exactly), since the direct OCR of the equity subtotal line was corrupted; the residual reproduces the sum of the individual equity components (paid-up + statutory reserve + revaluation reserve + retained earnings = 8,710,229,734) plus a 108,591 minority interest exactly, confirming it.
